info.name: Boiaro Mobile API
info.description: Complete REST API for the Boiaro mobile app — auth, chapters, ads, gamification, referral, and wallet.

item.name: Sign Up (with referral code)
item.description:
Creates a new user account.

- `referral_code` is optional — when provided and valid, both the new user and referrer receive coin bonuses.
- Save the returned `token` for subsequent requests.

item.name: 1. List Book Chapters (with unlock status)
item.description:
Returns all audiobook chapters with per-user unlock status. Auth is optional — unauthenticated calls get `is_unlocked: false` for all non-preview chapters.

Key response fields:
- `pricing_mode`: `per_chapter` | `whole_book`
- `chapters[].is_unlocked`: true if user can play this chapter
- `chapters[].is_free`: true for preview chapters (no unlock needed)
- `chapters[].chapter_price_coins`: coins needed to unlock individually

item.name: 2a. Unlock Chapter with Coins
item.description:
Deducts `chapter_price` coins from wallet and creates a permanent content unlock.

Response:
- `success`: true
- `coins_spent`: amount deducted
- `new_balance`: updated coin balance
- `already_unlocked`: true if already accessible (no charge)

item.name: 2b. Initiate Chapter Payment — SSLCommerz
item.description:
Starts an SSLCommerz payment for a chapter.

`success_redirect` / `fail_redirect` can be mobile deep links (`myapp://...`). Open `gateway_url` in an in-app WebView. Save `purchase_id` to poll status later.

item.name: 3. Poll Payment Status
item.description:
Poll after the user returns from the WebView. Check every 3–5 seconds.

Response:
- `status`: `pending` | `completed` | `failed`
- `is_unlocked`: true when the chapter is accessible — stop polling when this is true

item.name: 4. Get My Unlocked Chapters
item.description:
Returns all chapters the user can play.

- `full_book_unlocked: true` → user bought the entire audiobook, all chapters are accessible
- `unlocked_track_ids[]` → individual chapter IDs the user has unlocked
- `unlocked_chapters[]` → details + unlock timestamps

item.name: Get Ad Settings
item.description:
Public. Returns the full ad system configuration from platform_settings.

Key fields:
- `system_enabled`: master kill-switch for all ads
- `provider_type`: `adsense` | `none`
- `publisher_id`: Google AdSense publisher ID
- `web_banner_unit_id`: AdSense unit for web banners
- `rewarded_unit_id`: AdSense unit for rewarded ads
- `rewarded_coins`: coins per rewarded ad view
- `max_per_day`: daily cap on rewarded ads per user
- `cooldown_minutes`: minimum wait between rewarded ad views
- `premium_hide_ads`: whether premium subscribers see ads
- `country_targeting`: array of country codes

item.name: Get Active Banners

query.description: Filter by placement key (optional — omit to get all)

item.description:
Public. Returns active banners within their scheduled validity window.

Response per banner:
- `id`: use for impression/click tracking
- `image_url`: absolute URL, ready for `<Image>` component
- `destination_url`: open on tap
- `placement_key`: where to show this banner
- `device`: intended device (`mobile` | `desktop` | `all` | null)
- `impressions` / `clicks`: current totals

Common placement keys:
`homepage_top`, `book_detail_middle`, `book_detail_bottom`, `books_listing_top`, `gamification_page`, `dashboard_middle`

item.name: Get Active Placement Slots
item.description:
Public. Returns all enabled placement slot definitions.

Use this to know which placements exist before fetching banners for them.

Response per placement:
- `placement_key`: unique key for this slot
- `label`: human-readable name
- `ad_type`: `banner` | `rewarded` | `adsense`
- `device_visibility`: `mobile` | `desktop` | `all`
- `frequency`: display rule (e.g. `always`, `once_per_session`)
- `display_priority`: lower = shown first

item.name: Get Rewarded Ad Status
item.description:
Auth required. Call before showing the Watch Ad button to know if the user can watch an ad.

Response:
- `can_watch`: **the main boolean** — show the button only if this is true
- `remaining`: ads the user can still watch today
- `cooldown_seconds_left`: seconds left in cooldown (0 = ready now)
- `coin_per_ad`: reward the user will receive
- `today_count` / `daily_limit`
- `last_ad_at`: timestamp of last watched ad

item.name: Claim Rewarded Ad Reward
item.description:
Auth required. Call AFTER the ad has been fully watched and the ad network confirms completion.

`placement`: where the ad was shown (e.g. `mobile_player`, `chapter_unlock`, `gamification_streak`)
`ad_event_id`: optional — pass the ad network's rewarded callback event ID for deduplication

Response:
- `success`: true
- `reward`: coins awarded
- `new_balance`: updated wallet balance
- `today_count`: updated count
- `remaining`: how many more the user can watch today

Error responses:
- `400` `daily_limit_reached` — user has hit their daily cap
- `429` `cooldown` — too soon after last ad; includes `cooldown_seconds_left`

item.name: Get My Rewarded Ad History
item.description:
Auth required. Returns the current user's rewarded ad log.

Response:
- `today_count`: how many rewarded ads they've watched today
- `total_coins_earned`: lifetime coins from rewarded ads
- `logs[]`: full log entries with placement, coins, and timestamp

item.name: Record Banner Impression
item.description:
Auth optional. Fire when a banner becomes visible in the viewport.

Increments the banner's `impressions` counter. Silent — always returns `{ recorded: true }` even if the banner ID is wrong (to avoid crashing the app).

item.name: Record Banner Click
item.description:
Auth optional. Fire when the user taps a banner (before navigating to its destination).

Increments the banner's `clicks` counter. Always returns `{ recorded: true }`.

item.name: Update Ad Settings
item.description:
Admin only (role: admin | moderator). Update any subset of ad platform settings.

Allowed keys:
- `ad_system_enabled` — `"true"` | `"false"`
- `ad_provider_type` — `"adsense"` | `"none"`
- `ad_adsense_publisher_id` — Google publisher ID
- `ad_web_banner_unit_id` — Banner ad unit
- `ad_rewarded_unit_id` — Rewarded ad unit
- `ad_premium_hide_ads` — Hide ads for premium users
- `ad_free_show_ads` — Show ads for free users
- `ad_country_targeting` — Comma-separated country codes
- `ad_rewarded_coins` — Coins per rewarded ad view
- `ad_max_per_day` — Daily rewarded ad cap
- `ad_cooldown_minutes` — Wait between rewarded ads

Response: `{ updated: ["key1", "key2"] }`

item.name: List All Banners (admin)
item.description:
Admin only. Returns ALL banners including inactive ones (unlike the public `/ads/banners` which only returns active, in-schedule banners).

Optionally filter by `status` or `placement`.

item.name: Create Banner
item.description:
Admin only. Creates a new ad banner.

- `placement_key` is required — must match an existing placement slot
- `device`: `mobile` | `desktop` | `all` | null (null = show everywhere)
- `status`: `active` | `inactive`
- `start_date` / `end_date`: ISO 8601 strings; null = no restriction
- `display_order`: lower = shown first within the same placement

item.name: Update Banner
item.description: Admin only. Partial update — only include the fields you want to change. Null values explicitly clear a field (e.g. `"end_date": null` removes the expiry).

item.name: Delete Banner
item.description: Admin only. Permanently deletes a banner. Consider setting `status: inactive` instead to preserve the record.

item.name: List Campaigns
item.description: Admin only. Returns all ad campaigns ordered by creation date descending.

item.name: Create Campaign
item.description:
Admin only. Creates an ad campaign.

`ad_type`: `banner` | `rewarded` | `popup`
`status`: `active` | `paused` | `ended`

item.name: List All Placement Slots (admin)
item.description:
Admin only. Returns ALL placement slots including disabled ones (unlike the public `/ads/placements` which only returns enabled slots).

Save an `id` to use in the Update Placement request.

item.name: Update Placement Slot
item.description:
Admin only. Update a placement slot configuration.

- `is_enabled`: false = this placement won't return banners to mobile/web
- `device_visibility`: `mobile` | `desktop` | `all`
- `frequency`: `always` | `once_per_session` | `once_per_day`
- `display_priority`: lower = shown first

item.name: Ad Performance Report
item.description:
Admin only. Aggregated ad performance summary.

Response:
- `summary.total_impressions` / `total_clicks` / `ctr_percent`
- `summary.total_rewarded_ad_views` / `today_rewarded_ad_views`
- `summary.total_coins_distributed`: total coins awarded via rewarded ads
- `top_banners[]`: top 10 banners by impressions with individual CTR

item.name: List Rewarded Ad Logs (admin)
item.description:
Admin only. Returns rewarded ad claim logs across all users.

Optionally filter by `user_id` or `placement`.

Response:
- `total`: total matching log entries
- `total_coins_distributed`: sum of coins across filtered logs
- `logs[]`: each log has `user_id`, `placement_key`, `coins_rewarded`, `ad_event_id`, `status`, `created_at`

item.name: Get Full Summary
item.description: One-shot endpoint: returns streak, total points, badge list, and wallet balance in a single call. Use this for the gamification page initial load.

item.name: Update Streak (on app open)
item.description:
Call once per app open/login. Automatically increments the streak if the user was active yesterday, resets to 1 if they missed a day, and is a no-op if already updated today.

Response: the updated `UserStreak` record.

item.name: Add Points
item.description:
Award gamification points for an event.

Common `event_type` values: `chapter_listen`, `book_finish`, `review_written`, `daily_login`, `referral_complete`

item.name: Get Leaderboard
item.description: Returns the top 20 users by total gamification points with their rank, display name, and avatar.

item.name: Get My Badges
item.description: Returns all badges the current user has earned, ordered by earn date descending.

item.name: Get Badge Definitions (all badges that exist)
item.description:
Returns all active badge definitions — use this to show a 'badge gallery' with locked/unlocked states.

Key fields per badge:
- `condition_type`: `unlock_count` | `streak` | `ad_count` | `daily_login_count` | `referral_count` | `first_unlock` | `first_referral`
- `condition_value`: threshold the user must reach
- `coin_reward`: coins awarded when the badge is earned

item.name: Check & Auto-Award Badges
item.description:
Evaluates every active badge condition against the current user's stats and awards any that are newly met. Also credits coin rewards for newly earned badges.

Call this after key events: chapter unlock, referral completion, streak milestone, ad viewing session.

Response:
- `awarded[]`: array of `{ key, title, coin_reward }` for newly earned badges
- `awarded_count`: number of new badges earned (0 = nothing new)

item.name: Claim Daily Login Reward
item.description:
Claims the daily coin reward. Can only be called once per calendar day.

Reward amount is read from the `coin_daily_login_reward` platform setting (admin-configurable).

Response:
- `success`: true
- `reward`: coins awarded
- `new_balance`: updated wallet balance

Error: 400 `already_claimed` if already done today.

item.name: Add Goal
item.description:
Creates a new reading/listening goal.

`goal_type`: `reading` | `listening` | `chapters` | any custom string
`period`: `daily` | `weekly` | `monthly`
`target_value`: the goal threshold (e.g. 30 minutes, 5 chapters)

item.name: Log Activity
item.description:
Log a user action for analytics/activity tracking. All fields except `action` are optional.

Common `action` values: `play`, `pause`, `chapter_start`, `chapter_complete`, `book_open`, `search`

item.name: Log Consumption Time
item.description:
Record how long a user spent reading/listening to a book. Send periodically during playback (e.g. every 60 seconds, or on pause/stop).

`seconds`: time spent in this session — backend accumulates totals.

item.name: Get Referral Settings (public)
item.description:
Public. Returns referral program reward configuration.

Response:
- `signup_reward_coins`: coins the referrer earns when someone signs up with their code
- `referred_bonus_coins`: coins the new user earns for using a referral code

item.name: Validate Referral Code (pre-signup check)
item.description:
Public. Check if a referral code is valid before the user submits the signup form.

Response:
- `valid`: true/false
- `referrer_name`: display name of the referrer (to show 'You were invited by X')

item.name: Get My Referral Info
item.description:
Auth required. Returns the user's referral code and their referral history.

Response:
- `referral_code`: the user's shareable code
- `referred_by`: code of whoever referred them (null if none)
- `total_referrals` / `completed_referrals` / `pending_referrals`
- `total_earned`: total coins earned from referrals
- `signup_reward_coins` / `referred_bonus_coins`: current platform rewards
- `referrals[]`: history with status and timestamps

item.name: Get Coin Settings (public)
item.description: Public. Returns conversion ratio, daily ad limit, cooldown, and other coin system settings.

item.name: Claim Daily Login Reward (wallet route)
item.description: Alias for `/gamification/daily-reward` — prefer that one as it returns more context. Reward amount is read from `coin_daily_login_reward` platform setting.

item.name: Claim Ad Reward (legacy wallet route)
item.description: Legacy alias — prefer `/ads/rewarded/claim` which also supports cooldown checking and ad event ID logging.

item.name: Unlock Full Book with Coins
item.description: Unlock an entire book format (e.g. `audiobook`, `ebook`) for a flat coin cost. For per-chapter unlocks, use `/chapters/:trackId/unlock-coin` instead.

item.name: Check Content Access
item.description: Returns whether the current user has access to a specific book format. More lightweight than fetching full chapter list.
